label-gap.$description: Clear separation between a field label and its control.

prose.$description: Separation within a prose hierarchy or between paragraphs.

invitation.$description: Separation between a message group and its invitation.

target.$description: target size; target is the library’s 44px minimum control policy.

field.$description: field size; target is the library’s 44px minimum control policy.

action.$description: action size; target is the library’s 44px minimum control policy.

orb.$description: orb size; target is the library’s 44px minimum control policy.

lens.$description: lens size; target is the library’s 44px minimum control policy.

icon.$description: icon size; target is the library’s 44px minimum control policy.

body.$description: body type role; captions do not carry primary instructions.

label.$description: label type role; captions do not carry primary instructions.

caption.$description: caption type role; captions do not carry primary instructions.

title.$description: title type role; captions do not carry primary instructions.

mono.$description: Token labels and technical documentation only.

quick.$description: quick transition; reduced motion removes decorative travel.

response.$description: response transition; reduced motion removes decorative travel.

float.$description: float transition; reduced motion removes decorative travel.

disabled-opacity.$description: Disabled opacity; native disabled attribute remains authoritative.

field-focus-offset.$description: Inset field focus ring keeps labels and adjacent content clear.

phi.$description: Golden ratio for fluid section rhythm.

major.$description: Major share of available width after the content gutter.

minor.$description: Complementary share; vertical hero-water focal point.

focal-third.$description: Right-hand rule-of-thirds focal point for hero life.

control.$description: Rounded action ends retain the same curvature as a control grows wider; never a percentage ellipse.

inset-block.$description: Minimum vertical content clearance; controls grow when labels wrap.

inset-inline.$description: Rounded golden multiple of the 12px block inset; keeps words clear of curved edges.

content-gap.$description: Label-to-glyph separation; independent of the label length.

hover-background.$description: Editable field hover-background; invalid, readonly and disabled states keep their own appearance.

hover-border.$description: Editable field hover-border; invalid, readonly and disabled states keep their own appearance.

compact-height.$description: Compact form density keeps a full accessible control target while reducing visual height.

compact-label-gap.$description: Compact field label separation; focus ring remains inside the input.

header-height.$description: Compact navigation height, independent of viewport height.

hero-inset.$description: Minimum opening-scene copy inset; scales gently with viewport height.

hero-bottom.$description: Outer clearance below the primary invitation at the hero base. The base contributes its intrinsic height in normal flow.

copy-gap.$description: Space between the hero headline and introduction.

action-gap.$description: Space from the message to its invitation, and between wide-screen actions.

life-focus-y.$description: Hero water focal height, relative to its full section.

life-focus-narrow-y.$description: Lower focal height beneath the narrow-screen message and actions.

primary-width.$description: Compact intrinsic hero invitation; caps at available width rather than stretching across a phone.

base-gap.$description: Quiet orientation row to the final primary invitation at the bottom of the hero.

life-x.$description: Pisces focal point across the hero; each responsive composition may override it.

life-y.$description: Pisces focal point down the hero; each responsive composition may override it.

life-size.$description: Intended Pisces swimming-domain size in CSS pixels, capped by hero bounds. Layout breakpoints override this value.

eyebrow-gap.$description: Eyebrow-to-heading separation in a section heading.

copy-gap.$description: Heading-to-copy separation in a stacked section.

primary-width.$description: Compact section invitation, with room for descriptive audience or practice labels; capped by available width.

alternative-gap.$description: Primary-to-secondary spacing within one invitation, independent of viewport wrapping.

radius.$description: Capsule curvature independent of label length or control width.

foreground.$description: Readable action labels on the aubergine material.

background.$description: Quiet aubergine body beneath optical highlights.

border.$description: Functional outline remains distinct over moving water.

lens-size.$description: Silver orb keeps a stable optical size.

end-inset.$description: Clearance between the orb and the outer rim.

label-size.$description: Primary invitation labels remain readable across contexts.

sidebar-width.$description: Asset library track on wide workspaces.

sidebar-compact-width.$description: Asset library track on smaller desktop workspaces.

essential-height.$description: Minimum height of a core identity tile; content may grow.

deliverable-height.$description: Compact deliverable row with room for a useful description.

section-gap.$description: Related workspace sections remain close enough for an application view.

tile-padding.$description: Compact identity and seat interior spacing.
